en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a statue of Emperor Joseph II on a tall pedestal behind an ornate iron fence in a landscaped garden or park. Behind the trees stands a building with a domed tower. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Brüx and labels the monument as the Kaiser Josef-Denkmal. Additional German text is visible on the pedestal, including the name Kaiser Joseph II and his years of life.
